title: Accelerated surrogate dynamics for dynamical, stochastic system evolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.37184v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dynamic simulations are an entrenched way of gaining insight into the evolution of system dynamics. Their computational cost however is often prohibitively high, especially in cases of stochastic frameworks. Machine learning algorithms are especially suited as simulation surrogates. Nevertheless, they face some very distinct limitations. Firstly, the sheer dimensionality of these systems, however, precludes the use of traditional time series models who struggle with high dimensional feature spaces. Additionally, traditional time series focus exclusively on either long or short range effects, causing local or global drift given enough time. In this paper, we propose a framework that addresses those limitations. Our framework combines a Variational Autoencoder, with a convolutional or graph basis that reduces the dimensionality of the system. translated_title: 面向动态随机系统演化的加速代理动力学方法
translated_abstract: 动态仿真是深入洞察系统动力学演变的经典方法。然而，其计算成本往往高得令人望而却步，尤其是在随机框架的情况下。机器学习算法特别适合作为仿真代理，但它们面临着一些非常明显的局限性。首先，这些系统的庞大维度使得难以使用传统的时间序列模型，因为这类模型难以处理高维特征空间。此外，传统时间序列模型往往只关注长期或短期效应之一，在足够长的模拟时间后会导致局部或全局漂移。在本文中，我们提出了一个解决上述局限性的框架。我们的框架将变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoder）与卷积或图结构基础相结合，以降低系统的维度。该潜在向量通过时间融合Transformer模型在时间上传播，该模型包含……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将变分自编码器（用于降维）与时间融合Transformer（用于时间传播）相结合的加速代理仿真框架，解决了高维随机动态系统仿真成本过高以及传统时序模型因只关注长期或短期效应而产生局部或全局漂移的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an accelerated surrogate simulation framework that combines a Variational Autoencoder (for dimensionality reduction) with a Temporal Fusion Transformer (for temporal propagation), addressing the prohibitive computational cost of high-dimensional stochastic dynamical system simulation and the local/global drift issues of traditional time series models.
